name: Motto Shite Shite Onee-san
original_name: もっとしてしておねーさん
source:
Main character has spent his entire life in a hospital due to some health problems. Suddenly father gets an abroad appointment, and protagonist is moved to live with his older age girl cousin. He has no knowledge of girls - how will he fare?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公因健康问题一直住在医院里。突然父亲被调往海外，主人公被安排和年长的表姐一起生活。他对女孩子一无所知——他能应付得来吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
